notes.title: 🍄Merry Fungimas🍄
notes.notes:
🍄 Merry Fungimas, Fungiman Fans! 🍄

As the year comes to a close, I wanted to take a moment to express my gratitude to each and every one of you for being an integral part of the Fungiman community. Merry Fungimas! To celebrate this, I drew this Fungimas artwork for you! ːpraisesunː

But wait, there's more exciting news! ːMinionPigː  I'm thrilled to invite you to my website, https://pigasusdreams.com/ , where you can play a brand-new small HTML version of Fungiman!

Your continued support means the world to me, so once again, thank you from the bottom of my heart for being part of the Fungiman family.

Also, don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/MXJMYE47Se]Discord[/url] server and follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/pigasusdreams]Twitter[/url]! 

Happy 2019! ːceleste_strawberryː

notes.title: Nominate Fungiman in this year's Steam Awards!
Fungiman: The Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[b]It's been a long time since the last update. Now is the time to make up for it.[/b]

[h1][b]Today I present to you Fungiman: The Multiplayer Update[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409397/e4dc2544dda826e59b47016b3fee58a146b6443e.png[/img]

[b]This update indroduces a new multiplayer PvP mode where you can take on the role of the [i]Player[/i] or become [i]Fungiman[/i] himself![/b]

[b]I designed multiplayer game mode with a maximum of 2 players in mind, but it turned out that it can be a lot of fun when there are a lot of players, so there is no limit on number of people who can be in one game at the same time![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409397/c49fb2a37271ac53c822c8116aa0ccc6e07dbd92.png[/img]

[b]You can support me on Patreon! Fungiman is free and it will forever remain free, whether you choose to support me or not, so don't feel obligated to donate! That said, I will definitely be very grateful to you![/b]

[b][url=https://www.patreon.com/svinoman]https://www.patreon.com/svinoman[/url][/b]

[b]You can also join Fungiman [url=https://discord.gg/MXJMYE47Se]discord server[/url] where you can ask me questions, suggest ideas or just talk if you want :)[/b]

notes.title: A lot of great information
notes.notes:
[b]First and foremost, wow![/b] Fungiman just reached a [b]HUGE[/b] milestone of [b]15.000[/b] downloads! I totally didn't expect that, and I am extremely grateful for it.

During this month I've been working on the mobile version of Fungiman, but, sadly, I can't share any information about it here, so I decided to make a Fungiman [b][url=https://discord.gg/MXJMYE47Se]discord server[/url][/b], where I will share updates about all platforms, and where you can ask me questions, suggest ideas or just talk if you want :)

[b][url=https://discord.gg/MXJMYE47Se]https://discord.gg/MXJMYE47Se[/url][/b]

I also released a small update that allows you to invert the X or Y axis of the camera.

In the end, here's a cute art made by [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198981950507/]Fungi[/url][/b]. Thank you for playing Fungiman!

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
[b]Fungiman just reached one thousand downloads![/b]

I'd like you to know that more content is on the way, as well as a mobile version. In the meantime, however, if you want to help me, I ask you to leave a review on Steam, whether positive or negative, your opinion is very important to me!

Thank you so much for enjoying my game!
